shared_macros.semantics: HGFull checkmark, HGNone cross, HGPartial half-filled circle, HGWarn triangle. Outcome bar has exact T/(T+F+U), F/(T+F+U), U/(T+F+U) segments, no minimum-width inflation; T dark78%, F light18%, U white outline.

table_1.counts: All six research rows and original citations preserved.
table_1.semantics: Six evidence types are fully defined; no absent-capability cross or superiority ranking is introduced. Optional Browser, explicit domains, applicability/evidence-availability costs, normal alarms and unknown outcomes remain explicit.

table_2.counts: All eight material-row count pairs match baseline; controlled14×3×3 design retained in linked footnote.
table_2.semantics: Delta=effective modifications, N=normal records defined locally; record positions versus independent devices, training/development exposure, not-new-blind historical reserve, specialist normal-change and no-effect boundaries, geometry nonintegration and paired18+42 development history preserved.

table_3.counts: All 30 unmerged method cells match the baseline and CSV; five recipe weights, six totals/rates/misses and every nonzero delta preserved. Removing adjacent-cell merging improves column attribution without changing grouped weighting.
table_3.semantics: Full/partial/none restrict to tested modifications; per-original-recipe9 denominator, vector-equivalence grouping, weighted recipe counts, refitted ablations, RETENTION/FITTED, zero normal alarms/U/FAILED/EMPTY_MODEL and no-cap normal cost all preserved.

table_4.counts: All seven detection/normal-alarm fractions and all fixed-check labels preserved.
table_4.semantics: Detection symbols appear only in detection cells; warnings only for nonzero normal alarms. Both normal-change6 inclusions, no-effect memory6 exclusion, U/FAILED0 and standalone Host bound preserved.

table_5.counts: All four Integrated App and No-cap T/F/U triples plus N144/117 unchanged; eight macro arguments equal printed triples.
table_5.semantics: T alarm, F definite no alert, U unknown; 01/02 displayed together not pooled; FAILED/EMPTY_MODEL0. Full dark bar explicitly means all normal records alarm. Float is single-column table/columnwidth.

table_6.counts: N2/2/5/5/46 and T vectors2/0/0/0/0 versus2/0/5/0/0 preserved.
table_6.semantics: Normal row separated without detection symbol; row-specific T meaning, U/FAILED0 and development-use history preserved.
